learning_outcomes.text: Understand the organization's design and the economic and financial result of an enterprise.
Understand the social and ethical responsibilities of the company's decision-making process through the study of economics and organization.
Acquire knowledge of financial statements, financial assessment of the company, design variables of the organization, and organizational configurations.
Interpret the company's financial and economic results from the financial statements.
Understand relationships and characteristics of the organization's main design variables.
Draw up independent assessments of an enterprise's financial and economic reliability through budget data, analysis of the congruity of organizational processes and configurations adopted.
Present the results of exercises in the classroom and answer questions about choices made.
Acquire knowledge of economic-financial and organizational variables that characterize the company's decision-making processes.

syllabus_topics: The contents of the balance sheet
The contents of the income statement
Indices of indebtedness and financial independence
assessment_rules: The achievement of the objectives is certified by passing an exam. The exam consists of a written test and an oral exam that take place on the same day. The written test involves analyzing a company budget and is passed if at least 50% of the questions are answered correctly. The oral test is a discussion of approximately 40 minutes aimed at assessing the level of knowledge, comprehension, and language ownership.
